name: KOBAY
recent: Kobay Technology 在截至2026年9月30日的第一季度录得创纪录的1870万令吉净利，同比增长73%，营收为1.302亿令吉。公司多项与UA Materials的经常性关联交易实际金额超出股东授权上限，并已发出第32届常年股东大会通知。
notable: 第一季净利同比增长73%至1870万令吉，营收1.302亿令吉。
与UA Materials的多项经常性关联交易实际金额超出股东授权上限。
risks: 与UA Materials的经常性关联交易实际金额超出股东授权上限，需关注后续合规情况。
董事及主要股东在2026年9月至10月期间有多笔持股变动申报。
earnings: 截至2026年6月30日季度营收1.306亿令吉，净利1248万令吉，净利率9.6%；营收环比下降9.9%，净利环比下降11.3%，但营收同比增长54.4%。

recent_en: Kobay Technology posted a record net profit of RM18.7 million for 1Q ended 30 September 2026, up 73% year-on-year, on revenue of RM130.2 million. Several recurrent related party transactions with UA Materials exceeded the shareholder mandate, and the notice for the 32nd AGM has been issued.
notable_en: 1Q net profit rose 73% year-on-year to RM18.7 million on revenue of RM130.2 million.
Several recurrent related party transactions with UA Materials exceeded the shareholder mandate.
Proposed first and final single-tier dividend of 3.0 sen per share for FY ended 30 June 2026.
risks_en: Actual recurrent related party transaction values with UA Materials exceeded the shareholder mandate; monitor subsequent compliance.
Multiple changes in director and substantial shareholder interests were reported between September and October 2026.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM130.6 million and net income RM12.48 million, with a net margin of 9.6%; revenue fell 9.9% QoQ and net income fell 11.3% QoQ, while revenue rose 54.4% YoY.
